owner_problem_statement: Frankenstein frequently overestimates completion when transferring work from its own development/runtime context to Andreas's real Ubuntu Minisforum UM790 Pro. Self-modification can appear complete because build reality and target reality are nearly coincident. Foreign-host installation/build work is a domain transfer: driver state, permissions, user-session services, device reset behavior, timing, old state and host-specific lifecycle behavior are independent unknowns. Missing target-world evidence must never be interpreted as absence of defects.

primary_diagnosis.name: TRANSFER_DOMAIN_COLLAPSE_PLUS_MISSING_EVIDENCE_BLINDNESS
primary_diagnosis.summary: The system has strong component/effect/completion boundaries, but the project-level completion representation is still too artifact-centric. Build success, repository/CI success, simulated-host success, exact-target host binding and physical readback need separate evidence maturity classes. For a foreign host, unobserved dimensions are UNKNOWN debt, not PASS. Executor/self-report evidence must not promote target-host completion.
failure_modes: BUILD_STATE is treated too close to TARGET_REALITY_STATE
absence of observed failure is treated too close to positive proof
executor/self-report can dominate the context used to judge its own completion
environment identity is not always bound to every completion claim
transfer assumptions are implicit instead of represented as proof obligations
progress can rise by completing easy repository work while mandatory physical gates remain untested
a single scalar percent hides uncertainty, evidence maturity and unobserved host surface
foreign-host domain shift is not charged as explicit transfer/rework risk

required_state_model.rule: A requirement declares the minimum maturity class it needs. Evidence below that class contributes engineering progress but cannot satisfy the requirement. Host-specific evidence must bind the exact TargetEnvironmentIdentity generation/digest.

components: known failure classes with no falsifier
unknown_debt.rule: Unknown debt must lower confidence and widen ETA. It must never be silently normalized away because all known tasks are green.

host_reality_twin.target: Ubuntu on MINISFORUM UM790 Pro / Ryzen 9 7940HS class machine

hardware_reference.memory: DDR5 dual channel, platform supports up to 64GB in vendor spec
hardware_reference.network: 2.5GbE plus Wi-Fi 6E class adapter; vendor pages reference Killer AX1675 on some configurations
hardware_reference.ports: 2x USB4 40Gbps, 4x USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, 2x HDMI 2.1, audio jack, DMIC

host_reality_twin.accuracy_law: Do not claim silicon-identical emulation on a generic VPS. QEMU/KVM cannot faithfully emulate Phoenix firmware, Radeon 780M, USB4 controller firmware and all board quirks without real passthrough. Build a layered host-reality twin whose goal is interface/failure-surface fidelity, then calibrate it with an exact probe bundle from Andreas's machine.

layers.name: exact_host_fingerprint_import
requirements: one read-only probe bundle from the real Andreas host
installed host adapter and state paths
layers.rule: The twin profile is versioned from observed facts; guessed facts remain UNKNOWN.

layers.name: ubuntu_userspace_fidelity
mechanisms: same Ubuntu release and closest available kernel line
systemd PID1 plus real systemd --user instance
real D-Bus user/system buses
logind, udev, polkit and ACL behavior
Wayland-first desktop/session path plus explicit X11 variant
PipeWire plus WirePlumber
real filesystem layout, XDG paths and non-root user ownership

layers.name: device_surface_emulation
mechanisms: v4l2loopback or equivalent virtual camera sources with hotplug/drop/stall cases
snd-dummy/PipeWire virtual sources and sinks with default-device changes and disappearance/reappearance
virtual display/DRM or nested compositor paths for one/multiple display and Wayland permission cases
browser processes/profiles with locked profiles, remote-debug unavailable, permission prompts and restart
virtual/namespace network interfaces with rename/down/up/reconnect
USB attach/detach/reset semantics through available QEMU/USB or sysfs unbind/rebind paths

layers.name: fault_injection
mechanisms: tc netem for latency/jitter/loss/reorder/disconnect
dm-delay for storage latency
dm-flakey for periodic I/O failure
cgroup v2 CPUQuota/MemoryMax/IO limits plus controlled resource contention
systemd service kill/restart/start-delay
user-session logout/relogin and missing XDG_RUNTIME_DIR or D-Bus cases
permission revoke/regrant during active capture/audio/effect operations
device node renumbering and default-device switch
reboot/restart during partial install/update
clock-domain/skew injection at adapter boundaries where kernel-level emulation is not practical

layers.name: um790_specific_failure_profiles
profiles: unexpected black-screen/reboot class under low-power or graphics transitions
USB4 suspend/resume or boot enumeration failure class
Wi-Fi driver/firmware unavailable or reconnect class
audio source/sink reset and default-node churn
layers.rule: Where the exact firmware fault cannot be emulated, inject the externally observable consequence and verify Frankenstein's recovery/abstention. This earns pre-handoff robustness credit only, never physical acceptance.

grid10_unifieddb_completion_estimator.goal: Provide the same kind of remaining-work/ETA analysis that a human audit can produce, but from current UnifiedDB state alone at runtime. GitHub is optional provenance/export, not a dependency for the estimate.
required_db_event_families: evidence receipts with maturity class and environment binding
worker execution durations and resource use
grid10_unifieddb_completion_estimator.consistency_rule: ETA/progress reads one consistent UnifiedDB state generation. If required tables/projections are stale, conflicting or not bound to the same generation, return ESTIMATE_BLOCKED_STALE_STATE rather than fabricate a number.

grid10_role_projection.G2: current target-environment facts and target-match validation
grid10_role_projection.G6: empirical duration/rework statistics from historical UnifiedDB events
grid10_role_projection.G9: hyperposition fusion of optimistic/base/pessimistic completion hypotheses
grid10_role_projection.G10: bounded estimate/explanation projection; never completion authority

grid10_unifieddb_completion_estimator.compatibility_note: These are caller-supplied cognitive role labels over the existing ten-cell GRID10 ABI, not hardcoded semantic authority inside grid10_interface.py.

progress_model.mandatory_rule: Final completion remains boolean and gate-based. A percentage is diagnostic only.
progress_model.target_environment_match: For host-specific requirements, zero unless evidence is bound to the exact target environment identity/generation; simulated-host evidence may contribute pre-handoff engineering progress but cannot satisfy physical gates.
progress_model.unknown_penalty: Unknown debt lowers lower-bound progress and confidence; it does not get redistributed over known completed tasks.

eta_model.method: Critical-path remaining duration from dependency graph using empirical duration/rework distributions stored in UnifiedDB, conditioned by task class and environment phase. Add explicit domain-transfer/rework hazard for work not yet exact-host verified.
do_not_use: repository status cache when UnifiedDB is canonical/current
eta_model.cold_start: If duration history is insufficient, emit coarse ranges plus LOW confidence and list missing calibration instead of a precise timestamp.

anti_premature_victory: Completion estimator cannot consume the same executor's self-asserted DONE state as sufficient evidence.
Every mandatory requirement has a proof obligation and minimum evidence maturity.
Exact target-host readback is required where PRODUCT_COMPLETION_LAW requires real host acceptance.
The falsifier cell searches specifically for missing assumptions and unobserved required surfaces before any high-confidence completion estimate.
A high central progress estimate with mandatory host gates unverified must render NOT_COMPLETE explicitly.
If target environment changes materially, affected host-bound evidence is invalidated or downgraded automatically.

recommended_implementation_sequence: 1. Define TargetEnvironmentIdentity and environment-bound EvidenceMaturity/ProofObligation records.
2. Add append-only UnifiedDB project/work/evidence event families if any required event is not currently persisted there.
3. Build a consistent UnifiedDB project-state snapshot/projection; do not scrape GitHub at runtime.
4. Build GRID10 completion projection over that snapshot with unknown-debt and falsifier cells.
5. Add empirical duration/rework estimator and critical-path ETA with p50/p80 outputs.
6. Build the Host Reality Twin profile + fault scenario runner and archive pre-handoff receipts in UnifiedDB/repository provenance.
7. Make F2-WP-1108 clean-machine acceptance consume twin results as pre-handoff evidence but still require physical Andreas-host acceptance for final promotion.
8. Calibrate the twin from one exact read-only Andreas host fingerprint bundle; never overwrite observed facts with guessed defaults.
9. Add regression cases reproducing the historical failure: agent says DONE after transfer while required host evidence is missing; expected result must be NOT_COMPLETE/UNKNOWN_DEBT.
